summary: American Express Co filed an 8-K to report the issuance of $750 million aggregate principal amount of 3.835% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Notes due June 16, 2034, under a prospectus supplement dated June 10, 2026. The notes are senior unsecured obligations issued under an indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon as trustee. The filing is a routine debt offering disclosure, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situations category applies. The filing simply satisfies SEC reporting obligations for a standard registered debt issuance.
